title: Woody's Watersports
specs: What to Bring ALL 18 & older operators must have a VALID Government issued Photo ID on board vessel & must have a Credit Card/Debit Card in their name.
Alcohol & Drug Policy Woody's Watersports has a zero-tolerance policy for alcohol and drugs.
Customers who arrive under the influence, appear impaired, or attempt to bring alcohol or drugs onto a vessel may be denied participation.
Payment & Identification The person responsible for the reservation must present a valid government-issued photo ID at check-in.
